entities.name: L-lactate dehydrogenase 3
observations: The 316-residue query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q81XJ7 and 99.7% identical to other reviewed Bacillus homologs.
Catalyzes reversible NAD+-dependent conversion of (S)-lactate to pyruvate; EC 1.1.1.27; cytoplasmic enzyme.
Contains Pfam Ldh_1_N (PF00056) and Ldh_1_C (PF02866) domains.

entities.name: L-lactate oxidation
observations: (S)-lactate + NAD(+) = pyruvate + NADH + H(+). Rhea RHEA:23444; EC 1.1.1.27.
The reverse direction is pyruvate + NADH + H(+) = (S)-lactate + NAD(+), relevant to bacterial fermentation.

entities.name: Ldh sequence properties
observations: Length 316 aa; calculated molecular mass 34,770 Da; predicted pI 5.18.
Sequence-derived properties are computational estimates and do not establish catalytic mechanism independently.
